intro.text: A singer inspector in Hearthstone under Abiajan.

items.text: Dor was among the inspectors on duty when Lirin smuggled the Herdazian general Dieno into town as a litter bearer. A little more watchful than the others, Dor still missed him, thanks partly to a distraction from Roshone, just before Abiajan closed the town because Lezian had come looking for Kaladin.
